evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: The backlog contains multiple discovery/recommendation capabilities; this story does not depend on an obviously missing complementary CRUD capability (e.g., it does not require a separate 'create music' story within this backlog).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: This presumes a user profile exists and is populated, but the backlog has no story to create/manage user profiles or capture profile preferences; a complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similarity-based discovery requires user profiles/behavior data to exist, but there is no story to create/manage profiles or collect the data needed to compute similarity; complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: This can operate on existing videos/content; the backlog includes content ingestion (upload) and multiple similarity/info stories, so no clear missing complementary step is evidenced by this story alone.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Discovery via enriched metadata/tags implies a capability to create/curate that enriched metadata (beyond user-uploaded tags). The backlog has upload of tagged videos but no explicit story to generate/enrich metadata or manage tag vocabularies; complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This provides a creation/ingestion capability that other processing stories can build on; it does not expose a missing complementary prerequisite within the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnail sequences of segments presumes videos are segmented and thumbnails are generated. While admins can validate/edit segmentation, there is no story to perform initial segmentation or generate thumbnails; complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: The backlog includes multiple similarity-related capabilities and video ingestion; this story does not clearly require a missing complementary CRUD step beyond what is already represented.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity is a processing capability; the backlog contains related similarity and content ingestion stories, so no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations from similar profiles require profiles and similarity computation inputs; the backlog lacks stories for creating/managing profiles or collecting preference/behavior data, indicating a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: This requires obtaining the user's area (location) and ingesting/identifying relevant news events. The backlog has no story for capturing user location/preferences or ingesting news events; complementary capabilities are missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Receiving related information implies a source/knowledge base and a retrieval/linking capability for person entities; the backlog has no story to manage or integrate such an information source, exposing a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Providing related product information requires an external/internal product info source and integration; no backlog story covers creating/maintaining or integrating that information source, so a complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: To 'receive related information' about detected logos, the system needs a logo-to-info mapping/knowledge base and retrieval; the backlog lacks a story establishing that information source/integration.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification plus 'related information' requires a brand information repository/integration not represented elsewhere in the backlog; complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: This includes the necessary creation step (take/upload image) within the story itself and aligns with existing recommendation/discovery capabilities; no obvious complementary backlog gap is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based access requires videos to have geolocation metadata and a way to capture/assign it; the backlog has no story to geotag videos or ingest location metadata, indicating a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search can be implemented as processing over existing content; the backlog includes content ingestion and other search/discovery stories, so no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Validating/editing segmentation presumes an initial segmentation exists. The backlog lacks a story to automatically or manually create initial segmentations, exposing a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: This depends on the existence of 'news video segments' (segmentation) and a supply of news videos. While upload exists, segmentation creation is missing; thus a complementary prerequisite is absent.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking can operate on ingested videos; no necessary complementary CRUD capability is clearly missing from the backlog for this to be meaningful.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: This is an analysis capability over uploaded media; upload/ingestion exists, and no additional complementary step is clearly required in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering is a processing step over ingested content; the backlog includes ingestion and other prefiltering stories, so no obvious missing complementary capability is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: This is a filtering/search capability over assets; ingestion exists and no explicit complementary CRUD step is required by this story.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is an analysis step over ingested content; ingestion exists and no missing complementary capability is clearly implied.

evaluations.evidence: search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system or provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: Searching on system-recognized high-level metadata implies a capability to recognize/extract that metadata. The backlog has user-provided tags (upload tagged videos) but no general story to extract/recognize high-level metadata across content; complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: This depends on the existence of citizen annotations and Talk comments, but the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to annotate/classify or to create Talk comments; complementary capabilities are missing.

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientists based on annotations/Talk requires those annotations and Talk comments to be created/available; the backlog lacks volunteer-facing stories to produce them, exposing a completeness gap.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Identifying volunteer types requires volunteer activity/profile data and likely a way to capture it; the backlog has no stories for volunteer onboarding/profile management or activity tracking/classification creation, indicating missing complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification is an internal processing capability over existing images; no explicit missing complementary CRUD step is implied by this story within the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Detection is a processing capability over existing images; the story does not expose a missing complementary prerequisite in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: This is an analysis/processing capability over existing image sets; no complementary CRUD capability is clearly missing as implied by this story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification is a processing capability; the story does not evidence a missing complementary capability required for feature completeness within the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: This is an internal processing step; no explicit complementary backlog item is required by the story text.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Number detection is a processing capability over existing images; the story does not reveal a missing complementary prerequisite in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization is a processing capability; the story does not imply a missing complementary CRUD capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Detection is a processing capability over existing images; no missing complementary capability is clearly implied.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: This is an analysis capability over existing images; it does not expose a missing complementary backlog item.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification is a processing capability; no complementary CRUD step is implied as missing by this story.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis is a processing capability over existing videos; the story does not evidence a missing complementary prerequisite in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: This is an analysis capability over existing videos; no missing complementary capability is clearly implied by the story.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features ... in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Feature detection is a processing capability over existing images; the story does not expose a missing complementary backlog item.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: This presumes volunteers make classifications and that experience is tracked. The backlog lacks stories enabling volunteer classification submission and experience tracking, so complementary capabilities are missing.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering is a processing step over existing images; no missing complementary capability is implied by this story.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Detection is a processing capability over existing images; the story does not reveal a missing complementary prerequisite in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Noise removal is a processing capability over existing audio; no complementary CRUD capability is clearly missing as implied by this story.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping is a processing capability over existing audio segments/calls; the story does not clearly imply a missing complementary backlog item.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: This is an analysis capability over existing audio files; no missing complementary capability is evidenced by the story.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interrupting a volunteer presumes there is an interaction channel and an intervention mechanism (to actually interrupt) plus volunteer activity context. The backlog lacks stories to deliver interruptions or manage volunteer sessions, indicating missing complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Choosing interruption modality presumes the system can actually send/display interruptions in those media during volunteer activity; no backlog story establishes the interruption delivery mechanism, so a complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Educating a volunteer requires an education delivery mechanism and educational content to exist; the backlog lacks stories to create/manage educational content or deliver it in context, exposing a completeness gap.

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: This presumes the platform can deliver educational interventions and has educational assets available; no story covers creating/managing educational materials or delivering them, so complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an education piece presumes a repository/catalog of education pieces exists and is managed; the backlog lacks stories to create/curate educational content, indicating a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments presumes volunteers can create comments on subjects (Talk) and that comments are captured; the backlog has no story enabling volunteer commenting/Talk participation, so a complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot commenting presumes a capability for Zoonibot to post comments into Talk/subject discussions; the backlog lacks any story establishing bot posting/integration with the commenting system, indicating a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Giving explanations requires a delivery mechanism (posting/sending) and explanation content/templates; the backlog lacks stories to enable Zoonibot to deliver explanations, so complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining bot messages presumes the bot can communicate with volunteers via some channel and that message delivery is implemented; no backlog story establishes the communication/posting mechanism, exposing a completeness gap.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Grouping subjects presumes subjects exist and are created/ingested into the system. The backlog lacks any story to create/import/manage 'subjects' (core Zooniverse entities), so a complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: This requires tracking volunteer experiences/history and having a defined set of projects to recommend. The backlog lacks stories for capturing volunteer history/experience and for managing the project catalog, indicating missing complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarizing/reusing articles presumes articles are created/ingested and stored, but the backlog contains no story to create/import/manage articles; complementary capability is missing.
